title: Diptych with Targets and Vinyl 2
description: Two framed collages presented side by side, each densely layered with paper fragments, concentric-ring targets, vinyl-record motifs, and red rectangular elements on white grounds. Yellow ribbon stripes, red vertical bands, and scattered circular forms unify both panels compositionally.
composition: two framed panels, densely layered horizontal format
keywords: yellow ribbon stripe mixed media diptych
